isolation_requirements: No normalized exact-query overlap with v2-v12.
The generator and the frozen candidate configuration must be committed before the one-shot run starts.
A runtime seed must be recorded with the generated corpus and result artifact.
The generated corpus must not be opened, previewed, summarized, or used for any configuration change before scoring completes.
After the first completed scoring run, v13 is permanently consumed and may be used only for reporting/diagnostics.
post_consumption_policy: v13 must not be used to select or retune any routing model, representation, beta, threshold, margin, hybrid rule, or upstream parameter.
Further optimization requires a newly reserved blind-final protocol and a newly generated holdout after the next candidate freeze.
